notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign
notes.content:
We are currently running a Kickstarter campaign to we can improve and add new features to our game. We would really appreciate your support.

[h1]What you can get:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A very special thanks
[*] A copy of the game
[*] The digital OST
[*] A digital artbook
[*] Early access (access to the beta) only available to Kickstarter backers
[*] Printed artbook
[*] An official 3D printed figure
[/list]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/intertum/power-stealers-juego-gun-and-run]Link to the Kickstarter.[/url]
